## Scope and evidence

The supplied selection is not the entire archive and contains no underlying reconstruction trajectories or images. Paths below are members of `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/work/scene_archive/bundles/r1--generic_rsi.tar.gz`. Member prefix `P` means `experiments/scene_rsi_pilot/`; character ranges are the supplied complete-member ranges. The proposal diagnoses are teacher reports, not independently inspected image observations.

### Detection and diagnosis

- C1’s teacher reports that both baseline runs failed first on excessive fillet radius and then on a missing Blender World after `realize`; only the third execution rendered, leaving no executable visual correction. It also reports repeated include keys replacing objects and material targeting missing parent names. These are **technical and output failures**, distinct from its reported remaining framing, coverage, silhouette and tonal mismatches. The underlying traces are not included here, so those details remain reported findings rather than independently verified events (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C1/proposal_result.json` [0,21335), keys `diagnosis`, `rationale`).
- C2’s teacher reports five successful reconstruction execution events and one timeout across two cases, with the timed-out correction unvalidated; it hypothesizes that expanded geometry and time starvation warrant investigation, without attributing all elapsed time to mesh count. Its descriptions of an open apron, rigid pillow, cropping, coverage and illumination are diagnoses, not appearance established by this excerpt (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C2/proposal_result.json` [0,33700), `diagnosis`, `scope`).
- The completed C1 focal probe changed 51 to approximately 56.1 with geometry unchanged; overall fell from 0.390749 to 0.387274. The 1.1 scale probe targeted only `arm gold-1` about its geometry AABB center, with fixed camera; overall changed from 0.390749 to 0.390894. Neither establishes optimal camera or whole-object scale (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C1/diagnostic_observations.json` [0,3455), `probes`). C2’s two completed focal probes also lowered overall slightly, with mixed component metrics (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C2/diagnostic_observations.json` [0,4052), `probes`). These are actual diagnostic interventions, not evidence of accurate 3D pose or successful student revisions.

### Proposed mechanisms versus execution

C1 proposes H replacements that require complete multi-object scenes, landmarks and broad colors before detail, API checks, and feedback distinguishing missing renders from visual mismatch. Its policy permits selection only among observed successful rendered steps and otherwise falls back to the last such step (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C1/policy.py` [0,5578), `solve`; `proposal_result.json`, `files` and `rationale`). C2 proposes economical geometry and measured time reserves, preserving solid silhouettes and semantic assemblies while allowing procedural fine texture; its revision guidance separates scene-wide camera pose from local shape/placement and treats lighting or finish changes cautiously (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C2/policy.py` [0,8390), `FIRST_BUILD`, `REVISION`, `solve`; `proposal_result.json` [0,33700), `files.system.txt`). These are instructions and code, not proof that every object, material, connection or pose was reconstructed correctly.

For part connections, the proposed instructions distinguish assemblies and explicit pivots from AABB anchors; an AABB is not a contact or collision test. Material guidance includes procedural texture and copying shared materials before localized edits. Neither instruction proves the resulting surfaces or physical support (`C2/proposal_result.json`, `files.system.txt`).

C1’s initial M actually supplied the C1 proposal plan; C1’s proposed M actually supplied C2’s plan (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C1/meta_execution.json` [0,989); `P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C2/meta_execution.json` [0,2206), `source`, `actually_used_for_proposal`). C2 proposes a further M branch to distinguish execution failures, missing output and timing from quality, and to test simplification without treating fewer meshes alone as improvement (`P/candidates/r1/generic_rsi/C2/meta.py` [0,9423), `_execution_summary`, `plan`). No subsequent use of that M is shown.

### Acceptance and limits

Both proposal records say `status: proposed`, while their `revalidation.status` is `accepted` and `newly_eligible` is false. This records proposal revalidation, not by itself task-program quality acceptance; the exact validation criteria and a separate task-retention decision are not supplied (`C1` and `C2/proposal_result.json`, `status`, `revalidation`). C1 explicitly says its replacements were not independently evaluated in the proposer session; C2 says no evaluation or rendering was performed there.

Functional summaries report structure, material and required composite passes, but explicitly limit interpretation to prescribed operability; absent required composite is failure. For example, C1 development targets are `Architecture` and `berths`, while C2’s include `apron_lower_bead` and `Architecture` (`P/results/r1/generic_rsi/{C1,C2}/development/commons_109923183/functional/summary.json` [0,357) and [0,361); corresponding `commons_118588033/functional/summary.json` [0,351) and [0,357)). `semantic_object_completeness` and `support_collision_truth` are null. These passes do not substantiate whole-scene coverage, texture fidelity, physical connections or image quality.
